entities.name: PMID:25077715
observations: Developed a competitive serum ELISA for a titin fragment identified by mass spectrometry; tissue protease experiments attributed fragment generation primarily to MMP-2.

In dexamethasone-treated rats and a 56-day human bed-rest study, serum fragment decreased early and increased later during atrophy-associated exposure; bed rest value was 11.9% lower at day 1 and 16.4% higher by day 47.

entities.name: Serum Titin-MMP2 atrophy response
observations: A competitive ELISA for a primarily MMP-2-generated titin fragment showed early decreases followed by later increases in rat dexamethasone atrophy and human bed-rest studies, supporting a time-dependent association with atrophy-related muscle turnover, not a monotonic measure of muscle loss.
